summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing three Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns covering on-market share repurchases by the issuer under Main Board Rule 13.25A, the HK equivalent of a US issuer buyback disclosure. On 8 September 2026 the company repurchased 539,100 WVR ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average of HKD 49.4037, representing 0.0313% of shares outstanding, all held as treasury shares. The filing states no board recommendation, advisor, premium or price target; mechanics involve treasury-share retention without cancellation. Watch ongoing daily repurchase disclosures for pace, treasury-share accumulation and cancellation risk.
